FRENCH — MOCK EXAM #14
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. How do you say 'Here is my family.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. C'est mon frère.
   B. Mon frère s'appelle Kamau.
   C. Ma mère s'appelle Grace.
   D. Voici ma famille.

2. How do you say 'I have a brother and a sister.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Ma mère s'appelle Grace.
   B. Qui est-ce ?
   C. J'ai un frère et une sœur.
   D. Mon père s'appelle David.

3. How do you say 'Put the book on the table.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Le sac est dans la chambre.
   B. Mets le livre sur la table.
   C. C'est un lit.
   D. Mets le livre dans la chambre.

4. How do you say 'What day is it today?' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Le dimanche, je me repose.
   B. Quel jour est-ce aujourd'hui ?
   C. Demain, c'est jeudi.
   D. Le lundi, je vais à l'école.

5. What number is 'huit' in French? (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 18
   C. 20
   D. 10

6. How do you say 'Here is a present for you.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Mon anniversaire, c'est le 12 mai.
   B. Merci beaucoup !
   C. J'ai neuf ans.
   D. Voici un cadeau pour toi.

7. Read: Amina: Bonjour, Kamau ! Bon anniversaire ! Kamau: Merci, Amina ! Amina: Tu as quel âge ? Kamau: J'ai dix ans. Amina: Voici un cadeau ! Question: What does Amina wish Kamau? (1 mark)
   A. goodbye
   B. good night
   C. thank you
   D. a happy birthday

8. Read: Je m'appelle Amina. J'ai un frère et une sœur. Mon frère s'appelle Kamau. Ma sœur s'appelle Njeri. Question: How many brothers and sisters does Amina have in total? (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 4

9. What does 'Le ballon est derrière la porte.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. The bag is in the bedroom.
   B. Put the book on the table.
   C. It is a bed.
   D. The ball is behind the door.

10. What does 'Le vendredi, je danse.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. On Sunday, I rest.
   B. A week, seven days.
   C. On Friday, I dance.
   D. On Saturday, I play.

11. Which number is vingt-deux? (1 mark)
   A. 20
   B. 32
   C. 22
   D. 12

12. What does 'J'ai neuf ans.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. I sing and I dance.
   B. I am ten years old.
   C. I am nine years old.
   D. There is a cake and there are balloons.

13. What does 'Le matin, je mange du pain.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. It is not good for your health.
   B. In the morning, I eat bread.
   C. It is good for your health.
   D. They are mangoes.

14. Which little word goes with 'poisson' (the fish)? (1 mark)
   A. l'
   B. les
   C. le
   D. la

15. Which little word goes with 'poulet' (the chicken)? (1 mark)
   A. l'
   B. le
   C. la
   D. les

16. What does 'Touche ton nez !' mean? (1 mark)
   A. Touch your nose!
   B. I have ten fingers.
   C. I have two eyes.
   D. I have two feet.

17. Which little word goes with 'jambe' (the leg)? (1 mark)
   A. l'
   B. le
   C. les
   D. la

18. What does 'Elle est petite.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. He is tall.
   B. I have a mouth.
   C. She is short.
   D. He has short hair.

19. Read: Dans le salon, il y a un canapé et une télé. Le tapis est devant le canapé. Le chat est sous la table. Question: What is in the living room? (1 mark)
   A. a shower
   B. a bed and a fridge
   C. a garden
   D. a sofa and a TV

20. How do you say 'behind' in French? (1 mark)
   A. derrière
   B. sous
   C. sur
   D. devant

21. Fill in: Dans la cuisine, il y a un ______. (1 mark)
   A. canapé
   B. lit
   C. frigo
   D. tapis

22. How do you say 'the kitchen' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le salon
   B. le chat
   C. la cuisine
   D. la télé

23. How do you say 'I play' in French? (1 mark)
   A. je joue
   B. demain
   C. je chante
   D. je me repose

24. Which accent is on août? (1 mark)
   A. grave
   B. cédille
   C. circonflexe
   D. aigu

25. How do you write the number 25 in French? (1 mark)
   A. dix-neuf
   B. vingt-cinq
   C. trente et un
   D. vingt

26. Fill in: Le matin, je mange ______ pain. (1 mark)
   A. du
   B. de la
   C. des
   D. un

27. How do you say 'tea' in French? (1 mark)
   A. les haricots
   B. le thé
   C. l'eau
   D. le pain

28. How do you say 'the eyes' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le ventre
   B. les yeux
   C. le doigt
   D. le bras

29. How do you say 'It is raining.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Il fait chaud.
   B. Il pleut.
   C. Il fait beau.
   D. Il y a du vent.

30. Fill in: Le chat est ______ la table. (under) (1 mark)
   A. sur
   B. sous
   C. dans
   D. devant

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Translate into French: 'It is hot.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

32. Translate into English: 'J'ai un nez.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

33. Translate into English: 'Je m'appelle Njeri.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

34. Translate into English: 'Bon anniversaire !' (2 marks) (2 marks)

35. Translate into French: 'Excuse me, where is the school?' (3 marks) (3 marks)

36. Write the French words for: a song, a balloon, a party (3 marks) (3 marks)

37. Translate into French: 'I have ten fingers.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

38. Translate into French: 'There is a sofa in the living room.' (4 marks) (4 marks)

39. Translate into French: 'I sing and I dance.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

40. Translate into French: 'Put the book in the bedroom.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

41. Translate into French: 'I have two eyes.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

42. Translate into English: 'Je n'aime pas le poisson.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

43. Translate into English: 'Le chat est derrière la porte.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

44. Translate into English: 'C'est un gâteau.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

45. Translate into French: 'It is cold.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

46. Write the French words for: in, the door, the chair (3 marks) (3 marks)

47. Translate into English: 'Mon père s'appelle David.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

48. Translate into English: 'Ton anniversaire, c'est quand ?' (3 marks) (3 marks)

49. Translate into French: 'A week, seven days.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

1. D — Voici ma famille.
   Here is my family. in French is Voici ma famille.

2. C — J'ai un frère et une sœur.
   I have a brother and a sister. in French is J'ai un frère et une sœur.

3. B — Mets le livre sur la table.
   Put the book on the table. in French is Mets le livre sur la table.

4. B — Quel jour est-ce aujourd'hui ?

5. A — 8
   huit means 8.

6. D — Voici un cadeau pour toi.
   Here is a present for you. in French is Voici un cadeau pour toi.

7. D — a happy birthday
   Bon anniversaire.

8. B — 2
   She has one brother and one sister.

9. D — The ball is behind the door.
   Le ballon est derrière la porte. means The ball is behind the door.

10. C — On Friday, I dance.
   Le vendredi, je danse. means On Friday, I dance.

11. C — 22
   Vingt is 20 and deux is 2.

12. C — I am nine years old.
   J'ai neuf ans. means I am nine years old.

13. B — In the morning, I eat bread.
   Le matin, je mange du pain. means In the morning, I eat bread.

14. C — le
   poisson is masculine, so we say le poisson.

15. B — le
   poulet is masculine, so we say le poulet.

16. A — Touch your nose!

17. D — la

18. C — She is short.

20. A — derrière

21. C — frigo

22. C — la cuisine

23. A — je joue

24. C — circonflexe

25. B — vingt-cinq

26. A — du
   Du is used before masculine foods you do not count, like du pain.

27. B — le thé
   tea in French is le thé.

28. B — les yeux
   the eyes in French is les yeux.

29. B — Il pleut.
   It is raining. in French is Il pleut..

30. B — sous
   Sous means under.
